chunks: From him, from Safwan, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام, concerning:
Regarding the one who was unconscious, he said: He makes up whatever he missed.

key_terms.الْمُغْمَىٰ عَلَيْهِ: the person who has fallen unconscious
key_terms.فَاتَهُ: he missed or it passed him by
key_terms.يَقْضِي: he performs the make-up of missed obligatory acts

ai.seo_question: Does a person who was unconscious have to make up missed salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the person who falls unconscious and misses acts of salat (prayer). Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that such a person must make up all that was missed during the period of unconsciousness.
